descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S09 What the phone is showing x what the computer changes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry. (UAT TC-25 step 2; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything. (UAT TC-25 step 3; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 11; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh. (TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Both devices signed in with their own codes; {hospitalPatient} and {snfResident}

When For each row, put the phone on the screen named, make the change on the computer, and save the phone's checkpoint without reloading or tapping

Then D1 phone on the Hospital list, computer adds Hospital patient 'QA Sync D1': the card appears. D2 phone on the Nursing Home list, computer adds Hospital patient 'QA Sync D2': not on the Nursing Home list; it is there once the phone switches to Hospital. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint (spec), each with 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong' forbidden; no-reload proof from the phone's session log. D3 judges only the saved text, which starts the 60-character notepad preview (panels are Q5); D3 in an open editor is Q4 and S15

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
